name: Snetterton 300 Circuit
description: A Norfolk airfield circuit. Long straights, the tight Brundle and Nelson corners, and the fast Bombhole and Coram on the way back.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (190 of 1916 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
